name: Danielle R.
title: Exactly as described, zero surprises
body: We bought a 2020 Cherokee after touring three other lots. Tony's team sent a full inspection report before we even drove out. Paid by Zelle on a Tuesday and we were camping at Holly Oaks that Friday.

name: Marcus T.
title: They answered every question
body: First-time buyer, so I asked a lot. Never once felt rushed. The payment details came through email within an hour of placing the order and the tracking page showed exactly where things stood.

name: Priya S.
title: Delivered to our driveway
body: They handled delivery to Ann Arbor, walked us through every system on the Airstream, and followed up a week later to check in. That follow-up is why we referred two neighbors.

name: Kevin H.
title: Solid experience, minor wait
body: Unit needed one part that took a few days to arrive. They told me up front instead of letting me find out at pickup. Trailer has been flawless for four trips since.

name: Alicia M.
title: The inspection is the selling point
body: 120-point report, underbody photos, tire dates. I've bought two RVs before and never seen that level of detail from a used dealer. The Minnie Winnie started on the first try all season.

name: Tom & Renee B.
title: Trade-in was painless
body: Brought our old pop-up on trade, left with the Solis. Valuation was fair and honest, and everything was done in one afternoon. We'll be back when we upgrade again.
